internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
not_found: That could not be found. It may have been removed.
permission_denied: You are not allowed to do that.
bad_request: The request could not be handled.
validation_error: Some of the details are not valid. Check them and try again.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
registration_failed: Registration failed. Please check your details and try again.
weak_password: The password does not meet the rules listed under it.
authentication_failed: You need to sign in again.
session_expired: Session expired. Please log in again.
invalid_period: The period ends before it starts.
invalid_goal: This goal is not filled in correctly. Check its fields.
insufficient_data: Advice needs about a month of shopping and at least {{required_receipts}} receipts. So far: {{receipts}} receipts over {{days}} days. Keep uploading and it turns on by itself.
unsupported_media_type: Receipts come in as JPEG, PNG, HEIC or a PDF scan. The other files on this line are fine.
upload_limit_exceeded: The upload is over the allowed limit.
too_many_photos: You can upload at most {{max}} photos per receipt.
photos_too_large: The photos on this line add up to more than {{max_mb}} MB.
quota_exceeded: This month's AI credits are spent: left for about {{receipts_left}} receipts or {{messages_left}} messages. They renew on {{resets_on}}; typing by hand still works.
service_busy: The service has reached today's limit for reading and answering. Try again tomorrow.
message_too_large: The message is larger than receipt intake accepts.
categoriser_unavailable: The categoriser gave no answer. Nothing was changed; try again later.
advice_unavailable: Advice could not be worked out just now. Try again in a moment.
currency_locked: Cannot change currency once receipts exist.
category_move_target: Choose another category for its items.
category_not_yours: That category is not one of yours.
export_not_ready: The export is not ready yet.
already_in_household: You already belong to a household; leave it first.
not_in_household: You do not belong to a household.
owner_cannot_leave: Remove the other members before leaving the household you own.
cannot_remove_self: Leave the household instead of removing yourself.
member_not_found: No such member in your household.
invite_invalid: This invite link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
household_currency_mismatch: This household keeps its budget in {{household_currency}} and your account is in {{account_currency}}. Only accounts in the same currency can share a budget.
owner_only: Only the household's owner can do this.
unreachable: The server could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
trips_overlap: These dates meet the trip “{{name}}” ({{start_on}} to {{end_on}}). Trips cannot share a day.
per_diem_times: These times do not make a trip: it returns after it leaves, and the time abroad falls within it.
per_diem_no_rates: Per diem rates are kept for trips from {{start_on}} on.
per_diem_personal_trip: A per diem is owed for a business trip only.
invalid_export: This export does not go with that format.
email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email address first: we sent you a link.
disposable_email: Addresses from throwaway mail services cannot open an account.
email_domain_unreachable: No mail can be delivered to {{domain}}: check the address for a typo.
email_taken: This address cannot be used for the account.
link_invalid: This link has expired or has already been used.
terms_required: Accept the terms and the privacy policy to open an account.
two_factor_not_started: Start the setup again: scan the new QR code first.
two_factor_code_wrong: The code is not right, or the sign-in took too long. Try again.
second_factor_required: Turn on two-factor sign-in and sign in with it to open the admin pages.
super_admin_only: Only a super admin can do this.
admin_role_fixed: A super admin is set by the deployment and cannot be changed here.
discount_too_large: The discount is more than the chosen lines cost.
income_unreadable: The document could not be read. Try a sharper photo, or enter the amount yourself.
not_income: This doesn't look like money you received — a receipt goes in as a receipt.
child_read_only: A child in the household can only look at what it shares.
owner_role_fixed: The owner is always an adult.
month_closed: That month is closed: only this month’s entries can change.
needs_card: Income lands on a card: add one with it.
speech_unavailable: What you said could not be recognised just now. Try again or type it.
speech_too_long: A recording can be a minute long at most.
too_many_receipts: On the free plan one upload can hold {{max}} receipts. Send the rest separately.
